actionable_steps.citation: Royal Path to Divinity — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 32 (1999), 1999-04-15
actionable_steps.step: Love everyone — where love is, there God is. Make it your first practice, not your last resort.

actionable_steps.citation: Krishna's Prema Tathwa — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 22 (1989), 1989-08-24
actionable_steps.step: Don't stop at 'no hatred' — positively love all beings and actively engage yourself in acts of love.

actionable_steps.citation: Love is God's fragrance — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 31 (1998), 1998-04-29
actionable_steps.step: Give without keeping accounts — divine love always gives and never receives.

actionable_steps.citation: The Universe - the Guru — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 15 (1981 - 82), 1981-07-17
actionable_steps.step: Shower prema and keep sharing it — it thrives on thyaga (sacrifice); the moment you stop sharing, there is no more to share.

actionable_steps.citation: Fill your hearts with love — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 29 (1996), 1996-11-23
actionable_steps.step: If you wish to win the Lord, offer love and love alone — without love, you have no right to seek His love.

definition.citation: Sabko sanmathi — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 12 (1973 - 74), 1973-03-30
definition.quote: Prema is God. God is Prema. To consider it as a method of speech, an attitude of mind or as physical behaviour is to sorely demean it. Prema has no trace of selfishness; it is not bound by motives.

discourses.citation: You are born for your own sake — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 4 (1964), 1964-12-16
discourses.quote: Every being needs Prema inhales and exales Prema, for Prema is the basic breath; everyone is the embodiment of Prema. Love knows no fear, so love needs no falsehood to support it. Love seeks no reward; love is its own reward.

discourses.citation: Love is God's fragrance — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 31 (1998), 1998-04-29
discourses.quote: Divine love does not ask for anything. It is selfless. It is not mindful of praise or blame. Love is desireless and continuous; you will not find even a trace of selfishness. … Divine love always gives and never receives.

discourses.citation: Krishna's Prema Tathwa — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 22 (1989), 1989-08-24
discourses.quote: The Gita says, you must be without hatred to all beings - "adweshta sarva bhoothanam"; but, that is not enough. A wall has no hatred towards any being! But is that the ideal? No, you must positively Love all beings, actively Love, actively engage yourself in acts of Love. That alone wins the Grace you crave for.

discourses.citation: Royal Path to Divinity — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 32 (1999), 1999-04-15
discourses.quote: You may not undertake any sadhana (spiritual exercise), but never forget the Principle of Love. Never be afraid of troubles; sanctify your life with love. Love everyone. Where love is, there God is. Love is God. God is love.

make_it_real: Love is the basic breath — so breathe it out today: one act of love, given freely, expecting nothing back.
title: Love (Prema)

vahinis.quote: Everything is suffused with love (prema). So, we can unhesitatingly declare that the supreme Lord is the form of love (prema-swarupa). … But whatever the form, the essence cannot alter.
